# Customer churn to fintech: early-warning model (synthetic data)

An end-to-end project on predicting when bank customers reduce their transaction activity and move it to fintech or other digital providers.

**All customer data here is synthetic.** It is generated by `src/generate_dataset.py`, which simulates a 60,000-customer, 24-month panel with a deliberately planted speed and reliability effect. The schema mirrors what a bank would request from its data engineering team, so the modelling pipeline can be built and tested before real data is available.

## Contents

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `src/generate_dataset.py` | Simulates the panel, outage incidents, customer table, and ground-truth oracle |
| `src/build_dictionary.py` | Writes the data dictionary and maps each column to a real source system |
| `src/leakage_scan.py` | Single-feature AUC scan to flag columns that are too predictive on their own |
| `src/validate_dataset.py` | Sanity checks and a baseline gradient-boosting model with feature-group ablations |
| `data/data_dictionary.csv` | Every panel column: family, meaning, and the real source to request it from |
| `data/customers.csv.gz` | One row per customer, including churn month and survival fields |
| `data/outage_incidents.csv` | 42 simulated incidents for difference-in-differences tests |
| `data/monthly_market_benchmark.csv` | Monthly own-bank versus fintech speed benchmark |
| `data/ground_truth_oracle_DO_NOT_USE_AS_FEATURES.csv.gz` | True latent traits, for checking causal estimators only |
| `data/churn_panel_SAMPLE_300_customers.csv.gz` | 300 customers' full panel rows, for inspection |
| `docs/PROJECT_GUIDE.md` | Flowchart, leakage checklist, model recommendations, explainability steps, and the project walkthrough |

The full panel (about 1.3 million rows, 110 columns, roughly 240 MB) is not stored in the repository. Regenerate it:

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python src/generate_dataset.py                 # default: 60,000 customers, 24 months, seed 2026
python src/build_dictionary.py data
python src/leakage_scan.py data
python src/validate_dataset.py data
```

Options: `--customers 100000 --seed 7 --months 24 --target-churn 0.14`.

## Known limitations

- Synthetic data is easier than real data. Expect lower performance on real bank data. Use the numbers to check the pipeline, not as benchmarks.
- Labels are monthly horizons (1, 3 and 6 months). The project guide recommends a weekly grain to match 30, 60 and 90-day windows.
- The fintech-outflow family is a proxy of the outcome. The guide explains why it should be excluded from the primary model.
- The generator and dictionary are a teaching and prototyping tool. They are not a description of any real institution.
